coverage.notice: Coverage is incomplete. Gojatra republishes timetable data and states that it is compiled from Bangladesh Railway publications; the official e-ticket feed supplies train-number endpoints. Gojatra pages provide some route-pair times and off days, but do not establish every intermediate stop. Fare tables were not imported because the published prices are not consistently attributable to individual train records.
